basic_info.description: On the market for the first time in Decades, this legacy property is perfectly situated on the corner of 9th and Cabrillo. Flooded with light this two unit building has withstood the test of time.    The lower unit features two bedrooms and one bath, starting with a large living room and a flexible double parlor space that can be used as a bedroom or office. The back includes the bathroom and second bedroom.    The upstairs unit features three bedrooms and one bath, similar to the lower unit, except for the additional bedroom above the staircase. It also offers exciting potential to expand into the large attic space, providing further possibilities for renovation and customization.    Both kitchens could be a chef's paradise. Both kitchens offer great potential for renovation, with enough space to expand into the dining room or maintain the current layout, complete with a pantry and laundry room.    The garage is spacious, with room to park two, possibly three cars. It sits on a solid brick foundation that appears to be in good condition. The backyard features a large exterior staircase, along with a small deck on each level, adding to the outdoor appeal.  Both units will be delivered empty  First few photos are virtually staged
